title: Editor crash when using UID path within GDScript `extends`
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.6.1-stable, 4.6.3-stable ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.84 GiB memory ### Issue description When using a UID path for `extends`, the editor will crash with a "Cyclic Inheritance" error when the script gets reloaded. I expect either for the script to load correctly, or a visible compilation error in the script editor if `extend`ing by UID is unsupported. Currently there is no error highlighting, no error popup at the bottom of the scripting tab, and the editor crashes. `--verbose` log: ``` Loading resource: res://script_b.gd SCRIPT ERROR: Compile Error: Could not find class "uid://bnn8ano31oxrd" in "uid://bnn8ano31oxrd". at: GDScript::reload (res://script_b.gd:0) ERROR: Failed to load script "res://script_b.gd" with error "Bug". at: load (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:2907) Loading resource: res://main.tscn ERROR: Cyclic inheritance in script class. at: (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:598) Loading resource: res://script_a.gd Generated 'res://main.tscn' preview in 14184 usec Generated 'res://script_b.gd' preview in 20822 usec Generated 'ID:-9223370363159638024' preview in 124 usec ERROR: Cyclic inheritance in script class. at: (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:598) GDScript: Reloading: res://script_b.gd ================================================================ CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.6.3.stable.official (7d41c59c457bd5a245092b4e7eb2d833e3b3f8c3) Dumping the backtrace. BACKTRACE -- ================================================================ ``` Lack of error in scripting tab ### Steps to reproduce * Have 2 GDScript resources, `script_a.gd` extending Node and `script_b.gd` extending Node. * Copy the UID path from `script_a.gd` and replace the `extends Node` in `script_b.gd` with `extends "UID"`. Example: `extends "uid://bnn8ano31oxrd"` * Save the project. * If it doesn't crash, edit `script_b.gd`. Add a function, variable, even a single non-whitespace character should work. * Save the project. A crash is guaranteed at this point. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [uid_script_bug_2026-05-21_15-32-51.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28116975/uid_script_bug_2026-05-21_15-32-51.zip) The `main.tscn` is not needed. It was just there for me to test how it behaves on game launch.
